metadata.title: When You Accidentally Get 2 Kills and Valorant Acts Like You’re a Pro LOL
metadata.description:
Wait, did I just win without trying? 
Enemies must’ve blinked out mid-fight.
Click if your aim’s a mess but the scoreboard’s still flexing.
Valorant logic: still the biggest troll in town.

Tap if your kills are pure accidental magic!

#valorant #funnygaming #luckshot #gamingfails #shorts
